description: Query FEMA flood mapping, WGS landslide study coverage and inventory, liquefaction, mapped faults within 5 km, and an official Ecology cleanup lookup link. Cleanup site observations require documented commercial reuse permission. Supply a verified coordinate; results describe a point, not an entire parcel or structure. Each source declares unavailable/outside-study/no-mapped-feature states, observation times and required attributions. No absence claim establishes safety, disclosure compliance or insurance requirements.
